parameters.name: ImageUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the input image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is in a region other than Shanghai, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description:
The cartoon effect. Valid values:
- 0: retro comic (default)
- 1: 3D fairy tale
- 2: anime
- 3: fresh and clean
- 4: futuristic tech
- 5: traditional Chinese painting
- 6: battle general
- 7: colorful cartoon
- 8: elegant Chinese.
